//: VATHRAEL, A GREATER DEMON (docs/PLAN_demons.md D6; game/demon.h, game/demon_malice.h). His NAME is the glyph `summon_vathrael` (assets/spells/glyphs.json) -- NOT in the smithy cellar's book: only the debug switches grant it today (SANDVOX_ALL_NAMES=1, dev panel 'learn all demon names'). His BODY is the mob def `fiend` (assets/mobs/demon/fiend.*, demon.js's 2 m preset); his MANNER loose is the behaviors.json profile `fiend` (the full D4 kit, a deep pool, a long reach). He can be TALKED to from inside a circle like any demon, and he has a job for you (assets/dialogue/demon_vathrael.json: a quest hook). He cannot be held: his power is past anything a cellar circle reaches (salt, sulfur, quicksilver, candles and every iron pile you own come to ~60-80; he is 400, iron takes at most 30% of that), so a release is overpowered and the fight starts -- and his tells say so before you try.
name: Vathrael
//released: If a binding ever held him (it should not), he would serve on this neutral floor, his malice layered on it like the imp's.
//resist: Per channel, against a seal pile's potency. Set so the Harrowby cellar's own piles (sulfur 20, quicksilver 18) DO cut his channels: sealed, he has nothing he can do from inside, so he waits at the centre facing you (plan item 10) and can be talked to. His POWER is what no circle answers, not his channels. With less sulfur than that his gust opens the ring and his spells reach you while you talk.
//motive: Malice 90, cunning 90: he wants you dead and prefers the clever way; literalism 90: every loose slot of a duty is a door. A stock contract written for an imp is no contract for him.
